# RF Strategic Ltd.

> Business consulting and sales solutions for ambitious UK businesses.

RF Strategic partners with businesses to build sales strategy and operating
plans that get implemented, not just recommended — covering sales strategy,
business consulting, and revenue growth planning. Engagements follow a
four-stage process: assess, strategize, execute, grow.

This is a placeholder summary written during initial site build — update once
real service scope, target market detail, and founder background are confirmed.
